about_text: I’m Vitaliy — a Full-Stack Developer who loves clean code and sharp design. I craft modern web apps that blend elegant UI with solid engineering.
about_page_title: Who I am and what I do
about_page_lead: I combine development, technology, and product thinking to create modern web solutions.
bio_paragraph_1: I am a web developer who creates modern web products and works with both the client and server sides of applications. I develop frontend and backend systems, work with APIs, databases, and integrations, and connect analytics systems to track user behavior and support product growth.
bio_paragraph_2: I can deliver a web project entirely from scratch — from structure, architecture, and interface to server logic, integrations, analytics, and the launch of a finished product.
bio_paragraph_3: Another focus of my work is AI and prompt engineering. I work with large language models, create prompts, integrate AI functionality into web products, and use modern AI tools for automation and development.
bio_paragraph_4: I am also the founder and developer of the BigSPORT sports platform — my own product combining sports content, web development, analytics, and product thinking.
focus_products_text: From idea to finished web product
career_current_description: Developing web products, contributing to product decisions, implementing new features, integrating AI and analytics, and evolving product architecture.
career_fullstack_description: Building web applications from scratch, developing frontend and backend systems and APIs, and working with databases, integrations, and analytics.
career_frontend_description: Developing web interfaces, responsive layouts, working with JavaScript, and growing frontend application development skills.
career_start_description: Learning the foundations of web development, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, building first personal projects, and exploring the full development cycle.
backend_project_1_desc: An automated backend for creating news content on BigSport. The system parses news from football websites, processes the collected content using an AI model, and generates a new unique article from it. The finished material is automatically added to the BigSport website, where an editor can review and revise it before publication.
backend_project_capi_title: Prime Cleaner — Full Analytics & CAPI Backend
backend_project_capi_desc: Built a complete analytics infrastructure for the Prime Cleaner iOS app: integrated AppsFlyer to track installs and advertising sources, RevenueCat to manage subscriptions and payments, and Facebook Conversions API through a custom Node.js backend. Data about key actions and purchases is automatically sent to Meta to optimize advertising campaigns, while product analytics is sent to Amplitude to track user behavior.
backend_project_capi_short: Integrated AppsFlyer, RevenueCat, and Facebook CAPI via Node.js backend for end-to-end user tracking and ad optimization.

web_projects.title: Lux MIKROCEMENT
web_projects.desc: A company website for Lux MIKROCEMENT, which provides microcement services in Warsaw and throughout Poland. The website presents information about the company, its services, examples of completed work, and contact options.

web_projects.title: ChatShop — AI Storefront
web_projects.desc: AI-powered conversational storefront for e-commerce that turns traffic into customers through real-time product recommendations and guided shopping.

web_projects.title: HOUZ Music Records — Electronic Music Label
web_projects.desc: Official website of HOUZ Music Records — an underground electronic music label and platform. Includes releases, artist profiles, events, merch, and professional mastering with SEO-ready metadata and modern UI.

web_projects.title: Intelligent Writing — AI Content Agency
web_projects.desc: Official corporate website of Intelligent Writing — a next-generation AI content and research agency. Built with React and deployed on Firebase Hosting, it showcases the company’s services, portfolio, and technology-driven approach to writing and analytics.

web_projects.title: SkinHelper — AI-Powered Cosmetics Store
web_projects.desc: An innovative e-commerce platform with AI-driven skin analysis. The frontend is built with React, while the backend uses JavaScript with Express and an SQL database. Features include personalized AI skin diagnostics, product recommendations, and a modern shopping experience.

web_projects.title: Appmachine.store — Trusted Mobile Apps
web_projects.desc: A platform showcasing trusted iOS and Android apps — already published, always available. Built with React and deployed on Render.com, with EmailJS integration for customer communication and Microsoft Clarity for analytics.

web_projects.title: Busov — Freight Transport Services
web_projects.desc: A corporate website for cargo transportation in Kyiv and across Ukraine. Developed with React and Firebase, featuring an integrated EmailJS service for direct client inquiries and email notifications.

web_projects.title: Spilno — Community Social Network
web_projects.desc: An experimental social network for communities, developed with React and Firebase. Features real-time data, authentication, and a modern UI designed for interaction and engagement.
